defects.what: Header pins do not land on the perfboard's 2.54 mm grid (catalogue PERF_GRID origin = hole 1 at (2.5, 2.5)); jack pin grid conformance cannot be verified because the catalogue jack has no footprint pins.
defects.expected: every pin axis within 0.15 mm of a PERF_GRID hole (max residual <= 0.15): Pico pin-1 X in [2.35, 2.65] or [-0.19, 0.11] (mod 2.54), i.e. Pico origin x in [0.98, 1.28] or [-1.56, -1.26]; jack pins checked too.
defects.observed: max residual 1.130 mm (X residual 1.130 on all 40 pins, Y residual 0.000; Pico origin x=0.00, pin-1 at X 1.37 vs nearest grid columns -0.04 / 2.50); jack pins: UNVERIFIED (no data). Margin -0.98 mm. Note for Robin: with this grid registration the requirement conflicts with L2.1.3 (USB_MOUTH X in [-1.8,-0.8] forces pin-1 X in [0.87,1.87], best achievable residual 0.63 at x=+0.5), so it cannot pass as written unless the grid registration (not defined in requirements.md; catalogue marks it soft) or L2.1.3 changes.

summary: DOES NOT MEET (class CORRECT: all gates G0-G5 and every weight-3 L3 pass). 11 of 12 L1s pass on independent STL measurement; L1.1 fails only on L3.1.6.1 (weight 1): Pico header pins are 1.13 mm off the catalogue 2.54 mm grid in X, and jack pins are unverifiable. Weighted score 133/134 = 0.993; worst normalised weight-3 margin +0.20 (several checks sit at exactly 0.10 mm over limit: V-KO-TOP 0.100, V-KO-BOT 0.100, USB plug 0.400 vs 0.30, jack plugs 0.4005 vs 0.30); several weight-1/2 checks sit exactly on their limits (pilot depth 5.0, boss pilot depth 6.0, lip engagement 2.0). Observations (not verdict-changing): (1) L3.1.6.1 as written conflicts with L2.1.3 under the catalogue grid origin (best possible residual 0.63 mm for any Pico with USB_MOUTH in [-1.8,-0.8]) and the jack part.json has no footprint pins - a requirement/catalogue issue for Robin; (2) the end-wall/side-wall aperture slabs pick up the four blind corner-boss pilots (Z 8.1-14.1), treated as screw holes; (3) no render shows the interior lid-off (standoffs, lip not visible) and ghost_top colours jack 2 nearly like the board. Frame: design frame equals board frame; enclosure frame = +8.1 in Z, no rotation. claude-context MCP was unavailable this session; no code search was needed (only known paths read).
